note: What each feature needs from the llama.cpp engine build. minBuild is a llama.cpp release number (b11669 is 11669): a build older than that cannot serve the feature. unsupportedBackends maps a build id (vulkan, metal, cuda-12, ...) to the reason that backend cannot serve it at all. The floors are the first release containing the change that brought the feature to llama-server (verified against the llama.cpp git history, see ADR 0018) and are reviewed whenever the catalog pin moves; a custom build of unknown number is trusted.
